name: CloseButton
purpose: Icon-only convenience action for the familiar Close utility.

guidance.useWhen: Use when an icon-only Close action is conventional and the default Close label accurately describes the action.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for labelled business actions or when Close does not precisely describe the result.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use only for the familiar Close utility action; prefer Button or IconButton for other actions.

accessibility: Defaults aria-label and tooltip to "Close"; callers may override aria-label when the context requires a more specific accessible name.
knownLimitations: Avoid as a substitute for labelled business actions; use only for the matching familiar utility action.
